name: ZeroCostAI
description: We present a comprehensive empirical benchmark of 989 publicly accessible generative artificial intelligence software platforms operating in 2026. Evaluating cross-functional tools spanning LLMs, generative video, diffusion synthesis, speech cloning, and code intelligence, our audit quantifies subscription paywall architectures, trial deceptive practices, and honest zero-cost utility.Out of 989 audited tools, 68.2% exhibited upfront credit card capture mechanisms, restrictive 3-day conversion traps, or export watermarks. Conversely, 31.8% delivered genuinely sustainable zero-cost allowances, unmetered open-weight models, or anonymous zero-login execution.This open-access repository provides the formal benchmark whitepaper (PDF) and the machine-readable dataset (CSV) covering all 989 verified tools, cross-referenced with permalinks on the primary evaluation observatory: https://zerocostai.pro.
